dimensions.label: Configuration / Elaboration

dimensions.description: Modules, instances, containment, ports, and structural ownership.

dimensions.description: Port binding, signal drivers and loads, and bit-level connection facts.

dimensions.description: Data, control, guard, and priority dependencies in RTL logic.
